title: Use Map Overview right-side panel to view additional information (zoom into right panel)
summary: On the Map Overview HMI, the right-side panel provides additional information. This procedure helps you locate that right-side panel on the live Map Overview screen and use the UI zoom/focus behavior to view the additional information shown there.
when_to_use: When you are on the OptiSweep HMI screen labeled "Map Overview" and need to view the additional information that is shown in the right-side panel (including using the UI zoom/focus into that panel).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the "Map Overview" screen, locate the right-side panel, and use the available zoom/focus behavior to view the additional information.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the "Map Overview" HMI screen
Ability to zoom/focus the Map Overview UI (if available)

access_required: Access to the "Map Overview" HMI screen

visual_references.description: Map Overview frame showing the right-side panel area and the statement that it provides additional information; used as the visual reference for locating the right panel.

steps.title: Open the "Map Overview" screen and locate the right-side panel area
steps.purpose: To find the right-side panel on the live Map Overview HMI so you can access the additional information it provides.
steps.instruction: Open the HMI screen labeled "Map Overview" and locate the right-side panel area on that screen.
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the right-side panel area on the live "Map Overview" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The right-side panel area is visible on the "Map Overview" screen (i.e., you can point to the panel on the right side of the screen).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the right-side panel area on the "Map Overview" screen.

actions.label: Locate right-side panel on Map Overview
actions.exact_action: Locate the right-side panel area on the "Map Overview" HMI screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the right-side panel cannot be found, stop and request assistance from support.

steps.title: Confirm the right-side panel is the information area and zoom/focus into it
steps.purpose: To access the additional information that the right-side panel provides by using the UI zoom/focus behavior described for the next view.
steps.instruction: Using the Map Overview UI, confirm you are looking at the right-side panel information area, then zoom or focus into that right panel if the UI supports it (the training segment indicates the next view zooms into the right panel).
steps.expected_result: After zooming/focusing, the additional information shown in the right-side panel is visible to you.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI transitions to a zoomed/focused view of the right-side panel area, and the additional information in that panel is readable/visible.
steps.failure_condition: The right-side panel cannot be zoomed/focused, or the zoomed view does not show the additional information.

actions.label: Zoom/focus into right panel (if supported)
actions.exact_action: Zoom or focus into the right panel so the next view shows the right panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the right-side panel cannot be zoomed/focused, stop and request assistance from support.
Do not guess panel meanings beyond what is visible on the live Map Overview screen.

steps.title: Use the additional information shown in the zoomed right panel as context for the Map Overview screen
steps.purpose: To ensure the zoomed right panel information is actually used to understand what is shown on the Map Overview screen.
steps.instruction: Observe the additional information presented in the zoomed right panel and use it as the context for what is shown on the Map Overview screen.
steps.expected_result: You can reference the additional information displayed in the zoomed right panel while interpreting the Map Overview screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The zoomed right panel displays additional information (as indicated by the training segment) and you can use it to understand the Map Overview context you are viewing.
steps.failure_condition: The zoomed right panel does not display additional information, or the information is not visible/readable.

actions.label: Observe zoomed right panel information
actions.exact_action: Observe the additional information presented in the zoomed right panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot see the additional information in the zoomed right panel, stop and request assistance from support.
Do not guess panel meanings beyond what is visible on the live Map Overview screen.

success_criteria: Right-side panel on the live "Map Overview" screen is identifiable.
Zoom/focus into the right panel (when supported by the UI) results in the additional information being visible.
You can use the additional information shown in the zoomed right panel as context for interpreting the Map Overview screen.
healthy_conditions: Right-side panel is visible on the "Map Overview" screen.
Zoom/focus into the right panel produces a view where the additional information is visible.
failure_conditions: Right-side panel cannot be found on the "Map Overview" screen.
Right-side panel cannot be zoomed/focused to reveal additional information.
Additional information in the right panel is not visible/readable.
escalation_guidance: If the right-side panel cannot be found or cannot be zoomed/focused, stop and request assistance from support.
